issue.title: Add sase stats CLI views for the remaining seven Statistics tabs

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by phase sase-1m3.12 (note #3) from plan:202610/sase_stats_project.md §22.

Expose the remaining seven Admin Center Statistics views on the CLI as
`sase stats overview|runner|provider|activity|macro|plan|perf`. Per §22 each is a CLI
name plus a Markdown renderer over the existing Statistics loader, reusing what epic
sase-1m3 added for `project`: the `sase.stats.registry` view specs, CLI names, and
legends; the shared range grammar (`parse_stats_range`); the versioned JSON envelope
(`sase.stats.envelope`); and the `sase stats` group, whose bare form lists implemented
views ("There are no stubs"). Also move the Overview commits tile onto the
project-stats source, and add a `list` catalog once three or more views exist.

The rest of §22 (fleet-wide Runs, churn/growth series, sparklines, release tag,
cost/tokens, `--as-of`, role globs, CSV/auto formats, stable plan ids) stays recorded in
the plan as unprioritized ideas rather than tasks.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1m3 deliberately shipped only the project view (plan §22 lists the other seven as non-goals), so this is new product scope for a later plan.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1m3 built the sase stats group, registry, range grammar, and JSON envelope for future views but shipped only project; its acceptance phase proposed the other seven views as the natural follow-up.
